It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1916 and earlier in the [[Philippine Assembly]] from 1907 to 1916.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 18, 2020}} The district consists of the western Pampanga municipalities of [[Floridablanca, Pampanga|Floridablanca]], [[Guagua, Pampanga|Guagua]], [[Lubao, Pampanga|Lubao]], [[Porac, Pampanga|Porac]], [[Santa Rita, Pampanga|Santa Rita]] and [[Sasmuan]] since 1987.{{cite web|title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm|publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library|access-date=April 10, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/constitutions/the-1987-constitution-of-the-republic-of-the-philippines/the-1987-constitution-of-the-republic-of-the-philippines-ordinance/|title=THE 1987 CONSTITUTION OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES – ORDINANCE|website=Official Gazette of the Republic of the Philippines|accessdate=August 18, 2023}} Until 1972, it encompassed the eastern Pampanga municipalities of [[Apalit]], [[Arayat, Pampanga|Arayat]], [[Candaba]], [[Mabalacat]], [[Magalang]], [[Mexico, Pampanga|Mexico]], [[Minalin]], [[San Fernando, Pampanga|San Fernando]], [[San Luis, Pampanga|San Luis]], [[San Simon, Pampanga|San Simon]], [[Santa Ana, Pampanga|Santa Ana]], and [[Santo Tomas, Pampanga|Santo Tomas]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Gloria Macapagal Arroyo]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]], who served as the [[Speaker of the House of Representatives of the Philippines|House Speaker]] from July 2018 to June 2019.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 18, 2020}} This district has the distinction of being the only one ever represented by someone who had previously served as [[president of the Philippines]], as Gloria Macapagal Arroyo represents this district after leaving the presidency from 2010 to 2019 and again since 2022. {{clear}} == List of members representing the district == === Philippine Assembly (1907–1916) === {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" ! width="100px" | Portrait ! width="135px" | Member
